source_notes: Status=cancelled. Project rejected by Quebec province (Jul 2021) and federal cabinet (Feb 2022); no updates since. CBC, Natural Gas Intelligence, and CTV (three independent outlets) all document the federal rejection. Blank-ref fill of populated Status. Prior GEM-publication citation removed (circular).

Status=cancelled (import terminal). Quebec minister declared the project 'on hold for good' in 2011 after Gazprom withdrew (2009); never revived. CBC documents the 2011 indefinite hold. SINGLE independent non-GEM source corroborating the cancellation (the project went dormant rather than producing later coverage; Globe & Mail's Cacouna piece names Rabaska only in passing and does not document its end) — set yellow per re-verify single-source rule. Prior GEM-publication citation removed (circular).

Re-verified proposed: Fermeuse/Crown LNG plan announced Sep 2025; Hanwha Ocean signed strategic MOU 21 Jan 2026 (pre-FEED/conceptual studies, financing, shipbuilding, logistics). No FID, no construction — remains proposed. Hanwha press release, LNG Industry, and Natural Gas Intelligence (three independent outlets). See wiki note for the Hanwha development.

Re-verified shelved: Pieridae abandoned (Nov 2023) and sold Goldboro assets Jul 2024 (CAN$12M) to a numbered co. tied to Simply Blue Group; no new sponsor advancing it. CBC and Oil & Gas Journal (two independent outlets) document the sale. Owner attribution flagged to qa (see ownership note).

Re-verified shelved: no project updates in 2+ years; project website down and removed from NRCan LNG project list; Sep 2025 CBC Fermeuse coverage confirms Placentia Bay did not proceed; the NL government project registry (project-2177, Grassy Point/Placentia Bay) shows no advancement. Two independent sources (CBC and the NL provincial environmental-assessment registry).
